statusLine.command: input=$(cat); { mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/claude" && echo "$input" | jq -c '{rate_limits, at: now}' > "$HOME/.cache/claude/usage.json.tmp" && mv "$HOME/.cache/claude/usage.json.tmp" "$HOME/.cache/claude/usage.json"; } 2>/dev/null; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // empty'); pct() { [ -n "$1" ] && printf '%.0f%%' "$1" || printf -- '-'; }; if [ -z "$size" ]; then sz=''; elif [ "$size" -ge 1000000 ]; then sz=" of $((size / 1000000))M"; else sz=" of $((size / 1000))k"; fi; out=$(printf '\033[01;36m%s\033[00m' "$model"); [ -n "$effort" ] && out="$out | effort: $effort"; out="$out | ctx: $(pct "$used")$sz | 5h: $(pct "$five") | 7d: $(pct "$week")"; echo "$out"
